mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_cost_protection_rule ORDER BY priority ASC, id ASC
SELECT * FROM ai_cost_protection_rule WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY priority ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_cost_protection_rule SET protection_level = #{r.protectionLevel}, threshold_value = #{r.thresholdValue}, action = #{r.action}, priority = #{r.priority}, enabled = #{r.enabled}, rule_name = #{r.ruleName}, remark = #{r.remark} WHERE rule_code = #{r.ruleCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_cost_protection_log (action, from_level, to_level, target_type, target_id, operator, reason, detail, restored_at) VALUES (#{action}, #{fromLevel}, #{toLevel}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{operator}, #{reason}, #{detail}, #{restoredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_cost_protection_log ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM ai_cost_protection_log WHERE action = 'EMERGENCY_STOP' AND restored_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_cost_protection_log SET restored_at = #{restoredAt} WHERE id = #{id}
